_meta.purpose: Source of truth for accelerator + grant deadlines IR agent tracks. Drives /dashboard/admin/accelerators countdown + monthly investor-update bullets. Update via PR — IR daily brief flags any deadline within 14d.
_meta.audience: Founders preparing pitch / data room / SVI score for AU + global accelerators

accelerators.name: Antler Sydney
accelerators.fit: Pre-team founders + small teams. Strong for AU-based first-time founders.

accelerators.name: Startmate
accelerators.fit: Best AU accelerator for technical co-founder pairs with early traction.

accelerators.name: Techstars Sydney
accelerators.fit: Global mentor network. Strong for B2B SaaS with paying customers.

accelerators.name: Y Combinator
accelerators.fit: Highest-quality network globally. AU founders increasingly admitted. Best fit for ambitious B2B SaaS.

accelerators.name: Berkeley SkyDeck
accelerators.fit: University-affiliated, strong AU pipeline via Pad-13 partnership.

accelerators.name: muru-D (Telstra)
accelerators.fit: Telco / B2B / enterprise SaaS. Telstra Ventures follow-on.

accelerators.name: Blackbird Giants
accelerators.checkSize: Up to AUD $750k pre-seed / Up to AUD $5M Series A
accelerators.fit: Best AU/NZ VC. Apply when you have 12+ months MRR data and a credible $1B+ vision.

grants.name: ESIC (Early Stage Innovation Company)
grants.checkSize: Tax offset for investors (20% rebate up to AUD $200k/yr)
grants.fit: If you qualify, your raise dilution drops 10-20% because investors get tax-back. CHRO + CLO must confirm 100 / 500 / gateway tests pass.
evidenceNeeded: 100/500 tests met OR gateway tests via principles-based

grants.name: R&D Tax Incentive (ATO)
grants.checkSize: 43.5% refundable tax offset on eligible R&D spend (revenue < AUD $20M)
grants.fit: Free 43.5% rebate on AI / software R&D spend. Apply via AusIndustry + ATO. Lodge by Apr 30 each year.

grants.name: Industry Growth Program
grants.fit: AU SMEs in priority sectors (digital tech is one). Matched dollar-for-dollar.
